description: Datadog monitors for Trust & Safety. All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [T&S] Spike in user reports
[T&S] Pending reports backlog growing
[T&S] Spike in user blocks
[T&S] Spike in spam detection rate
[T&S] Zero moderation activity detected
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No moderation actions have been recorded in the last hour. This may indicate the moderation pipeline is down, or reports are not being addressed.

**Actions:**
1. Check the moderation API health endpoint.
2. Verify the Supabase connection for the reports table.
3. Ensure moderation staff are active and the queue is visible.
4. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [T&S] High-risk dating behaviour users detected
[T&S] No spam detection activity
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No spam has been detected in the last 24 hours. While this could be a positive sign, it may also indicate the spam detection service is not functioning correctly (e.g., not receiving message traffic, or the detection pipeline is broken).

**Actions:**
1. Verify the spam-detection service is processing message traffic.
2. Check for recent deployments that may have broken the integration.
3. Review message volume to confirm normal traffic patterns.
4. Manually test with known spam patterns.
{{/is_alert}}
